articles.title: Hamas political official and wife among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
articles.description: The killings are the latest from a series of near daily attacks by Israel against what it says are Hamas targets.

articles.title: Five Russian military jets hit in airfield strike, says Ukraine
articles.description: The Savasleyka airfield hosts aircraft used by Russia to launch hypersonic missiles and glide bombs at Ukraine.

articles.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
articles.description: Swiss officials said relations would be kept through North Korea's embassy in Bern, and its own embassy in Beijing.

articles.title: Eurostar trains cancelled and delayed over 'unannounced strike action'
articles.description: Several Eurostar trains have been cancelled or delayed due to "unannounced strike action", the company said.
